about_the_game:
About 30 mins

"Confess, You Pitiful Believer! – Sister Isabella’s Harsh (But Adorable?) Teachings ASMR"

—— “You foolish believer, do you really think you can still be saved?”
—— “Hmph… Fine, since you're already kneeling here… Ugh, hurry up and thank me for my mercy!”

Have you ever imagined sitting in a dimly lit confession booth, being harshly scolded by a super chuuni nun teacher? Your sins are heavy, and your only salvation is to listen to Sister Isabella’s "merciful teachings"!

But don’t be fooled into thinking this is just a normal confession! How naïve!
This nun is not only brimming with chuuni energy but also struggles to keep a straight face when reciting some of her own dramatic lines (?!). She may interrogate you with the authority of a saint, but in the next moment, she might get flustered by her own script. Is this a holy redemption… or an inescapable torment? The choice is yours!

🎧 ASMR Features:
✨ Immersive Confession Experience – Under Sister Isabella’s strict guidance, you’ll go through a "holy inquisition" like never before! (But she might break character halfway through.)
✨ Multi-layered Voice Acting – Stern scolding, gentle whispers, and unexpected shy murmurs—all to satisfy your ears!
✨ Custom BGM & Ambient Sound – Feel the presence of a solemn yet slightly intimidating confession booth for a fully immersive experience!
✨ Chuuni Dialogues + Improvised Reactions – “You are not even worthy to gaze upon me… Ah, wait, this is an audio drama, so I guess that doesn’t matter.”

Confess now… or do you wish for Sister Isabella to personally deliver your punishment? 💀✨
